claims: As of early 2026, Nicolás Maduro Moros is the de jure president of Venezuela.
Nicolás Maduro Moros has held power since 2013.
Nicolás Maduro Moros was captured by US forces on January 3, 2026.
Nicolás Maduro Moros was transported to the U.S. to face drug trafficking charges.
Following Nicolás Maduro Moros's capture, Delcy Rodríguez began acting as president within Venezuela.
According to the NBC News report, Nicolás Maduro and his wife Cilia Flores were captured in a U.S. operation in Caracas, Venezuela.
According to the NBC News report, Nicolás Maduro and his wife Cilia Flores are currently in the United States facing indictments for narco-terrorism, cocaine trafficking, and weapons charges.
According to the Wikipedia article on the President of Venezuela, Delcy Rodríguez has assumed presidential powers following the capture of Maduro.
According to the NBC News report, Maduro’s legal team has filed to dismiss the charges, arguing he is the legitimate head of state and should not be tried in the U.S.
According to an Al Jazeera article, supporters in Venezuela have held protests demanding the release of Maduro.
Maduro is a former union leader.
